note: Every component this tranche renders must have a governing specification in legal-design-specifications.json. All five do, and none was authored here.
whyNone: Both routes are pure custom pleadings. Neither carries a process_guidance component, so no guidance specification is needed for either. The instructions component on il-immediate-seal is itself a custom_pleading component with its own drafted custom-pleading specification.

governingSpecification.venue: The courtroom in which the case is disposed. The petition is filed with the circuit clerk during that hearing.
governingSpecification.filingRule: The petition is filed with the circuit court clerk on the same day and during the same hearing in which the case is disposed. LegalEase generates the packet in advance and hands it to counsel. LegalEase cannot appear in the courtroom and cannot file during a hearing.
governingSpecification.noticeRule: The court is required to inform the defendant of the right to immediate sealing and of the procedure.
governingSpecification.serviceRule: A copy is served on the State's Attorney in open court and on no one else.
governingSpecification.signatureRule: The participant verifies the petition. Section 5.2(g)(5)(A) frames the filing itself as made by the defendant's attorney on the defendant's behalf.
governingSpecification.feeRule: The source review states no fee for this route.
governingSpecification.feeWaiverRule: Supreme Court Rule 298 Application for Waiver of Court Fees where a county fee applies.

governingSpecification.venue: The circuit court with jurisdiction over the underlying conviction, the Chief Judge of that judicial circuit, or any judge of the circuit designated by the Chief Judge.
governingSpecification.filingRule: File the motion and proposed order with the circuit court with jurisdiction over the underlying conviction, or with the Chief Judge or a designated judge of that circuit. No statewide form exists, so confirm the filing method with the clerk.
governingSpecification.noticeRule: The State's Attorney receives notice and has 60 days to object with supporting evidence.
governingSpecification.serviceRule: The subsection does not clearly state whether the clerk serves as under § 5.2(d)(4) or the movant serves as in the cannabis suite. Confirm local practice before assuming clerk service.
governingSpecification.signatureRule: The movant signs the motion. Name, address, phone, email and a pro se designation where unrepresented.
governingSpecification.feeRule: The source review does not state a fee for this route. Treat county charges as county-specific and confirm with the clerk.
governingSpecification.feeWaiverRule: Supreme Court Rule 298 Application for Waiver of Court Fees where a county fee applies.

designInconsistencyRecorded.finding: The component specification lists a manual completion item placed on a 'Filing instruction sheet', but the adopted packet set for this track contains two components only — the motion and the proposed order — and no instructions component.
designInconsistencyRecorded.whatWasDoneInstead: No third component was invented. The filing-method confirmation is recorded in tranche-4-field-ownership.json as an item the participant completes, and the motion itself says the filing method and the service model are confirmed with the clerk. Counsel is asked in the legal-output recommendation whether the packet set should gain an instructions component.
